full_prompt_en: A square marine illustration shows two powerful sailfish crossing through a burst of blue ocean water. The upper fish surges diagonally from the left toward the upper right, its long spear-like bill pointing outward and its high indigo dorsal sail opened behind the head. The second fish runs across the center toward the right, slightly closer to the viewer, with a similarly extended bill, pale underside, striped blue flank, and dark raised fin. A third, softer fish shape swims behind them at left. White spray and foamy blue strokes explode around their bodies, while a small patch of green-brown coral and sea plants occupies the lower center. The scene sits within a largely white page-like square: energetic brush splashes fade outward into unpainted pale margins rather than meeting a hard rectangular horizon. The fish are anatomically detailed, with glossy eyes, gill plates, narrow jaws, fin rays, and gold lateral flashes. Their sleek forms are rendered with careful blue, turquoise, violet, and warm tan strokes, while the water is much looser and more gestural. Highlights along the bills and bellies make them appear wet and metallic. Diagonal movement dominates the image, yet the coral patch anchors the base. There are no boats, humans, logos, captions, or readable words. The effect is celebratory and kinetic, combining natural-history attention to marine anatomy with the splash and color of a sports illustration. The open white paper helps the blue forms seem to break beyond their own painted environment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形海洋插画呈现两条有力旗鱼交叉穿过蓝海水花。上方的鱼从左斜冲向右上，长矛般尖嘴伸出，头后的深靛蓝高背鳍张开。第二条鱼横穿中央朝右，更靠近观者，带同样伸长的尖嘴、浅腹、条纹蓝侧身和高起深鳍。左后方还有第三条较柔的鱼形。白色飞沫和泡蓝笔触在鱼身周围爆开，下中部一小片绿棕珊瑚与海草稳定画面。场景置于大片白色纸页般方框内：有力水花向未画满的浅边缘消散，而不是被硬矩形地平线截住。鱼的解剖细致，有亮眼、鳃盖、窄颌、鳍条和金色侧闪。流线形体以细心蓝、青、紫及暖棕笔触绘出，水则更松散、更有动作。嘴和腹部高光使其湿亮带金属感。斜向运动主导图像，珊瑚块锚住底部。没有船、人、标志、说明或可读字。效果欢腾且富动势，把自然史式海洋解剖观察与运动插画的水花和颜色结合。开放白纸让蓝色形体像冲出自身绘画环境。
style_prompt_en: Use vivid natural-history illustration with precisely observed focal forms embedded in loose, explosive watercolor-like splashes. Let elongated diagonals and flared thin structures create movement, while a small dense texture near the bottom anchors the composition. Work mainly in cobalt, turquoise, indigo, violet, and bright white, with slender warm gold accents. Reserve unpainted paper around the action so saturated marks feather outward into pale space. Render focal surfaces with fine ribs, glossy highlights, and subtle anatomical planes, but keep surrounding fluid or atmosphere gestural and broken. The image should feel energetic and celebratory, balancing scientific detail with brushy spontaneity.
style_prompt_zh: 采用鲜明自然史插画，把精确观察的焦点形体嵌入松散爆开的水彩般飞溅笔触。让拉长斜线和张开的薄结构产生运动，底部一小片密纹稳住构图。主用钴蓝、青绿、靛蓝、紫和亮白，辅以细暖金重音。动作周围保留未画纸面，让饱和笔迹向浅空处羽化。焦点表面画出细脊、湿亮高光和微妙解剖平面，周围流体或空气则保持破碎且有手势感。图像应有能量、欢腾，并在科学细节与自发笔势之间平衡。
theme_en: Two sailfish leaping through a bright blue spray above a reef
theme_zh: 两条旗鱼在礁石上方跃过明蓝水花
name: Guy Harvey
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
